answer: Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. The spiral of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The wander lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the signal is where a second reviewer recomputes them. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, burned when the recruit misbehaves, the unit of trust is a task, not an address.
